filterSourceNote.message: Matrices a ho etsisa a thehiloeng ho lipatlisiso tsa Viénot 1999 & Brettel 1997.
filterSourceNote.description: Footer note crediting the scientific sources of the filter matrices.

infoTooltipText.message: Mokhoa oa ho etsisa o bontša hore na leqephe le shebahala joang ho motho ea nang le bothata ba ho bona mebala - e thusa baqapi ba ho lekola mosebetsi oa bona. Mokhoa oa ho lokisa o sebetsa ho daltonization ho fetola mebala e ferekanyang hore e be mebala eo basebelisi ba sa boneng mebala ba ka e khethollang habonolo.
infoTooltipText.description: Tooltip text explaining the difference between simulation and correction modes.
